test_case.query: How do I escape the mansion?
test_case.description: Should explain LIBERTY puzzle with 7 books

test_results.generated_answer:
To escape the mansion, you need to collect at least some of the lettered books and guess the command word "LIBERTY." Once you have done so, speak the word within 10 feet of the double door in room M1. This will open a portal back to Candlekeep's study for one minute. According to Document 1, this is the climax and escape from the mansion.

Be cautious when exiting as an invisible imp may attack you upon leaving the mansion through the portal. If you defeat it, it disappears in a cloud of black smoke.

test_case.description: Should mention Cumin and Coriander in the kitchen

test_results.generated_answer: The homunculi are Cumin and Coriander. According to Document 1, Cumin was created by Fistandia, while Coriander was created by a mage named Freyot. Both are unusual in that they can speak Common and are very eager to serve the party. They run the kitchen (M6) and dining room (M8), insisting on serving bread and soup whenever possible.
